stops.note: described the sickness an older child develops when displaced from the breast by a new baby
stops.meaning: the disease of the deposed child

stops.note: introduced to medical English by pediatrician Cicely Williams studying childhood malnutrition in Ghana
stops.meaning: a severe protein-deficiency disease in children

current_meaning: A severe form of childhood malnutrition caused by protein deficiency, marked by swelling, skin changes, and stunted growth.
